name: utility-bar
title: Utility bar
description: A slim bar above the header with the practical things: phone, email, an open-now line in words, and language and login links.
docs: Give it phone, email, status and links. The phone and the email are tel: and mailto: links whose text is the number and the address themselves, so they can be read, copied and printed; phoneHref sets another tel: address for a number with an extension. status is the shape OpeningHours takes, { open, text }, worked out on your side from your clock in the business's time zone: the bar shows your words with a filled dot when open and a hollow one when closed, so it never leans on colour. Below sm only the phone and the status show; the email appears from sm and the links, which belong in the main menu on a phone, from md. Between md and lg the email makes way for the links, so the bar stays one row on a tablet, and it returns from lg. With no phone and no status the bar is not drawn where it would be empty: below md when it holds only links, below sm when it holds only an email. A link in another language takes lang, so a screen reader pronounces it right. linkAs renders your router's Link and labels translates the fixed words.
